description: Find Teletype conversations by status (open/close/unanswered/all), channel, client, tags, operator, category, last message text, or client name. The query parameter searches last message text or client name, not dialog IDs. If the user already supplied dialog_id, pass it directly to read_conversation_thread, resolve_conversation, or send_reply_to_client as appropriate. For text in older messages use find_messages and continue through pages. Each result includes link_to_dialog. Show every conversation to the user as a clickable Markdown link. Use this tool for the active queue, unanswered conversations, a client's history, or tagged cases. For several dialogs of one client, prefer read_client_history.

category.description: Conversation category name. List available categories with list_workspace_metadata(resource='categories').

channel.description: Channel name (eg 'WhatsApp Sales') or its type (telegram, whatsapp_teletype, email, vk, viber, instagram_direct_business, etc.). Resolves automatically.

channel_type.description: Channel type for filtering (for example: telegram, whatsapp_teletype, email, vk, viber, instagram_direct_business, etc.).

client.description: Name, phone, email or client_id - filter by client.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return. Default: 20. Allowed range is 1 to 100.

operator.description: Agent name (full or partial) or 'unassigned' string for dialogs without an assigned agent.

page.description: Results page number (default 1). Pages beyond the last one return an empty list.

query.description: Search query based on the text of the last message or client name (case-insensitive substring search).

response_format.description: 'concise' (default) keeps the text output short. 'detailed' adds per-item fields to the text output (ids, statuses, timestamps, full message texts). structuredContent always contains every field regardless of this parameter.

status.description: Filter by status. Default is 'open'. Use 'unanswered' for triage.

tags.description: Client tag names. All listed tags must match. For example, ['VIP', 'refund'].

name: find_conversations
title: Find conversations
